_comment: Merge the hooks block below into ~/.claude/settings.json (or a project's .claude/settings.json). PostToolUse on Task/Agent captures subagent type, model, and task description; SessionEnd marks session boundaries; UserPromptSubmit re-states the active task's delegation mode from tasks/todo.md (silent unless it is external-worker). PreToolUse on Bash runs git-guard: it denies git commit/push in a repository outside the session's project and asks before main/master. SessionStart runs staleness: it reports a stale skill-forge.json profile (skf sync --check).
